mapper.select: select r.*, u.nick_name as author_nickname, c.category_name as category_name, f.original_name as original_name, f.content_length as content_length, f.content_type as content_type from resource r left join sys_user u on r.author_id = u.user_id left join resource_category c on r.resource_category_id = c.category_id and c.deleted = 0 left join file_object f on r.file_object_id = f.object_id and f.deleted = 0 where r.resource_id = #{resourceId} and r.deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into resource
author_id, resource_type, resource_category_id, title, summary, description, file_object_id, link_url, link_icon, status, review_status, publish_time, download_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
values
#{authorId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceCategoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{fileObjectId}, #{linkUrl}, #{linkIcon}, #{status}, #{reviewStatus}, #{publishTime}, #{downloadCount}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now()
mapper.update: update resource set deleted = 1, update_time = now() where resource_id = #{resourceId}
update resource set download_count = download_count + 1 where resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: select resource_id from resource where status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' and deleted = 0
select count(*) from resource where resource_category_id = #{categoryId} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update resource set resource_category_id = -1, update_time = now() where resource_category_id = #{categoryId} and deleted = 0

select.if: select resource_id as resourceId, count(*) as cnt from resource_like where resource_id in #{rid} group by resource_id
select resource_id as resourceId, count(*) as cnt from resource_collect where resource_id in #{rid} group by resource_id
select resource_id as resourceId, round(avg(score), 2) as ratingAvg, count(*) as ratingCnt from resource_rating where resource_id in #{rid} group by resource_id
